description: The page, size and sort query parameters that Spring MVC turns into a Pageable, with page counted from zero and a default size of 20.
The value property,direction such as name,desc, where a repeated sort parameter sorts by several properties.
The Spring Data wrapper that renders a Page as a stable JSON object with a content array and a page object holding the totals.
The size, number, totalElements and totalPages members that let a client draw page controls without guessing.
A pair of signals for the page index and the sort whose values feed the httpResource request, so changing one sends a new request.
Returning to page 0 whenever the sort or a filter changes, because the old page number may not exist in the new result.
The fixed set of property names a server accepts in sort, since Spring copies the names from the request without checking them.
